decides: U+S+C pass: the capped switch closes the measured gap without clipping a loud title, and is a fix candidate pending the owner's ears. DL measures how far the title's own program moves the same balance; a D balance gain well under B's (B's +7.65 against D's 3.6-5.2 offline) says the switch overshoots on crosstalk bins and wants a weaker crosstalk weight. DC decides whether the faithful path (use_dsp on: the program, its reverb and its levels) can run on the Nova at all, which ranks it against the switch.
